summary: System1, Inc. filed an 8-K on May 29, 2026, disclosing a comprehensive debt exchange under an Exchange Agreement between its subsidiaries and all existing term and revolving lenders. The transaction repays all existing loans and revolving commitments in exchange for new $150 million Priority Term Loans, 39,250 shares of Series A Cumulative Convertible preferred stock, and a cash payment of $1.25 million. The exchange settles outstanding disputes and is subject to conditions. Watch for closing mechanics and potential impact on equity value.
